MATH biofoundry-gates
BIND ManagerApproved = true FROM [urn:subactor:resource:sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa]
BIND ActiveBioreactors = 2 UNIT count
BIND MaxActiveBioreactors = 4 UNIT count
EXPR CapacityWithinLimit = LTE(ActiveBioreactors, MaxActiveBioreactors)
EXPR SceneRebuildAllowed = AND(ManagerApproved, CapacityWithinLimit)
